prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Scaling the parent's successful locality coefficient from 2.0 to 4.0 (x2) strengthens the only mechanism shown to pay off, pushing more adjacent critical pairs onto the same tier and thus lowering crit_cross further, at the cost of a slightly weaker cut term relative to the total.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.134 robust(mean-std)=-0.005 min_case=+0.008 seed_std=0.067 tns_mean=+0.040 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.114 dWNS=+14.3% dTNS=+10.7% per-seed=[+0.06 +0.04 +0.24]
  C2: score=+0.008 dWNS=+4.3% dTNS=-0.7% per-seed=[+0.08 +0.01 -0.07]
  C3: score=+0.011 dWNS=-3.2% dTNS=+3.4% per-seed=[+0.03 -0.06 +0.06]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->134, wcut 421->384, crit_cross 0.011->0.005, repair_flips 103->121, changed-vs-baseline 14.4%
  C2: cut 318->307, wcut 1007->966, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->237, changed-vs-baseline 7.2%
  C3: cut 582->577, wcut 1955->1934, crit_cross 0.069->0.051, repair_flips 353->350, changed-vs-baseline 5.0%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response: (1) Partially: crit_cross fell on C1 (0.011→0.005) and C3 (0.069→0.051), but C2 was already 0.000, so the mechanism had no headroom there; total gain is dominated by C1. (2) C1 drove the win (dWNS +14.3%, dTNS +10.7%) with cut/wcut down and repair_flips up 103→121 — consistent with more critical pairs co-located but more repair churn. C3 improved TNS but WNS regressed (-3.2%). (3) No: seed_std=0.067 and robust=-0.005 mean the mean gain is within noise; C2/C3 per-seed include negatives. (4) Re-run with more seeds and gate on robust score, or apply the x4 coefficient only to C1-scale circuits.
